name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's racing journey began not on the track, but in the garage. As a young boy in Santiago, he spent countless hours tinkering with his father's old rally car. This hands-on experience fostered a deep understanding of vehicle mechanics, which later proved invaluable when he transitioned into race strategy. His early career involved stints with local karting teams, where he quickly gained a reputation for his meticulous planning and data analysis. 

Ricardo is known for his pragmatic and data-driven approach to strategy. He believes in minimizing risk and maximizing opportunities based on detailed simulations and real-time track data. While he may not be the most flamboyant strategist, his teams consistently benefit from his clear-headed decision-making under pressure. Ricardo distinguishes himself by prioritizing long-term strategic goals over short-term gains, building a foundation for sustained success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height, with a sturdy build that hints at his years spent working on cars.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten track notes.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Chilean coffee before every race.
